issues: v09 is acceptable, with notes. The brand is right: a pale, puckered patch of raised ridges on the inner LEFT forearm, which is turned across his body toward camera just above the bandaged wrist. It has no legible letters, no numerals and no cross. Nagoji matches his sheet: thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin with only a faint jaw shadow, gold ear drop, wet torn ochre tunic over red rope welts with no blood, and no irons. The Fisherman, in red lungi and shoulder cloth, gestures and talks beside the Woman. The Young Fisherman (indigo, headband) takes the legs. The Woman has a grey-streaked low knot, undyed cotton over both shoulders, no blouse and no gold. She works a cloth in her hands and looks down at the arm. There is no painted text and no balloons, and the hands are sound. Notes: (1) The weather does not match the page. The sky is grey and overcast and the surf behind is rough, while 5.1 to 5.3 are bright and sunny under a blue sky. The location matches (laterite house, thatch, village edge, wet ground like the wet path in 5.2), so this is a lighting shift, not a wrong setting. A warmer colour grade would reduce it. (2) Her expression is a slight downturned look with dark reddish lips rather than a clear betel half-smile. (3) She stands in front of the doorway rather than mid-step out of it. Lettering: both WOMAN balloons fit in the open grey sky at top left, above and left of the Fisherman's head, or in the dark doorway and laterite wall at upper right above the Young Fisherman's headband, with tails to her mouth. v02 is rejected as backup. Its brand is a crisp, scrolled, tattoo-like monogram that reads as letters (roughly 'NR' or 'AR') even at full-frame size. That is pseudo-text, and it breaks the bible's 'blurred past reading, no legible letters'. Its sunny sky would otherwise match the neighbouring panels better.

issues: Acceptable, with only minor deviations. Nagoji matches the sheet: thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin with at most light stubble, small gold ear stud, long curly black hair, rope burns on his chest, tunic off, cream dhoti on, bandage on one forearm.
